rows.label: Employee tax credit (Verkehrsabsetzbetrag), per year
rows.note: Credits are deducted from the tax; the pensioner credit and the employee credit cannot both apply. Low earners may receive part of their social insurance back (SV-Rückerstattung) on assessment.
rows.source_title: BMF: Steuerabsetzbeträge (last updated 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Supplement to the employee tax credit (Zuschlag, assessment only)
rows.value: €804 up to €19,761 of income, phasing out evenly to nil at €30,259
rows.note: Credits are deducted from the tax; the pensioner credit and the employee credit cannot both apply. Low earners may receive part of their social insurance back (SV-Rückerstattung) on assessment.

rows.section: 13th and 14th salary (sonstige Bezüge): fixed tax rates within the annual sixth
rows.label: First €620 of special payments (€0 to €620)
rows.basis: Special payments (holiday and Christmas pay, bonuses) up to one sixth of the regular pay of the year, after the social insurance on them
rows.note: With steady pay the annual sixth equals two monthly salaries, i.e. the 13th and 14th salary (§ 67 EStG).
rows.source_title: BMF: Das Steuerbuch 2026 (Wien 2025), chapter F. Sonstige Bezüge, pp. 67–68

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Flat-rate or simplified income-tax regime
rows.value: None: profits are taxed on the income tax tariff; flat-rate expense deduction (Basispauschalierung, Kleinunternehmerpauschalierung) is available instead
rows.note: Self-employed people also register with the SVS and pay a fixed accident insurance contribution and 1.53% for self-employed provision (details in the next section).

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound regime (Zuzugsbegünstigung)
rows.value: Incoming scientists and researchers: 30% of their income from scientific work tax-free for 5 years (Zuzugsfreibetrag); details in the section below
rows.note: Self-employed people also register with the SVS and pay a fixed accident insurance contribution and 1.53% for self-employed provision (details in the next section).
rows.source_title: BMF: Zuzugsbegünstigung (last updated 1 January 2026)

rows.source_title: migration.gv.at (Austrian federal government): Start-up Founders

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad or freelance visa
rows.value: None: no remote-work permit; the self-employed use the Red-White-Red Card (key workers, start-up founders) or the stay permit for self-employed persons
rows.note: Self-employed people also register with the SVS and pay a fixed accident insurance contribution and 1.53% for self-employed provision (details in the next section).
rows.source_title: migration.gv.at (Austrian federal government): Temporary residence

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Application authority
rows.value: Austrian embassy or consulate, or after legal entry the residence authority (Land government, district authority, or MA 35 in Vienna); the AMS assesses the economic benefit. Tax: Finanzamt Österreich
rows.note: Self-employed people also register with the SVS and pay a fixed accident insurance contribution and 1.53% for self-employed provision (details in the next section).
rows.source_title: migration.gv.at (Austrian federal government): Self-employed Key Workers
